doc.brief: Used to configure the focus behavior in the `GTK_DIR_TAB_FORWARD` and `GTK_DIR_TAB_BACKWARD` direction, like the <kbd>Tab</kbd> key in a [`ListView`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListView).
doc.md:
Used to configure the focus behavior in the `GTK_DIR_TAB_FORWARD`
and `GTK_DIR_TAB_BACKWARD` direction, like the <kbd>Tab</kbd> key
in a [`ListView`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListView).

all.brief: Cycle through all focusable items of the list
all.md: Cycle through all focusable items of the list

cell.brief: Cycle only through a single cell, then move focus out of the list.
cell.md:
Cycle only through a single cell, then
  move focus out of the list. Moving focus between cells needs to
  be done with the arrow keys. This is only relevant for
  cell-based widgets like `GtkColumnView`, otherwise it behaves
  like `GTK_LIST_TAB_ITEM`.

item.brief: Cycle through a single list element, then move focus out of the list.
item.md:
Cycle through a single list element, then move
  focus out of the list. Moving focus between items needs to be
  done with the arrow keys.
